title: MELAC: Massive Evaluation of Large Language Models with Alignment of Culture in Persian Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on newly curated datasets specifically grounded in Iranian culture, such as Iranian legal frameworks, Persian literature, and localized religious rules (Islamic and Zoroastrian), to expose the performance drop caused by Western-centric training data.

Assessing model performance on the intricacies of the Persian language, including complex verb conjugations, idioms, and homographs, to demonstrate the linguistic performance gap in underrepresented, non-English languages.

Comparing the accuracy of models on multiple-choice benchmarks when using numerical (1-10) versus alphabetical (A-J) option identifiers to investigate if models exhibit an innate preference for specific prompting formats.
